First, we need to ensure 24v and 0v. As per schematics.
Also, we need to check the Loose/Faulty Connections at XD7 terminal as highlighted in the above picture,

we recommend having spares while site intervention.

We should take one when going onsite, or sent to the service partner.
So we can solve it in a 1 stop .

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0430844/DC/Si-D/BE-[MP / S6 170003777]Plug 2 is out of order CRM:02681000320 - Urgent: No update received regarding yesterday’s intervention at Merelbeke
additional_info.body:
Dear
I am writing to express our serious concerns about the lack of communication following your intervention yesterday on our (ultra-fast) charging station in Merelbeke.
It is extremely disappointing that nobody informed us about the outcome of your visit. I had to check in SCB (Siemens platform) myself, only to discover that not only is plug 1 still offline, but now the entire charging station appears to be completely offline!
We have not received any update or explanation about:
What the issue is
Why the situation has worsened
What actions were taken during the intervention
What the next steps and timeline are to resolve this
This is unacceptable, especially given the impact on our operations and customers. Please provide a detailed update as soon as possible, including:
The root cause of the current issue
An explanation for the complete outage
The immediate actions you are taking to restore functionality
A clear timeline for resolution
We expect transparent and proactive communication going forward.
Looking forward to your prompt reply.
Met vriendelijke groeten | Cordialement | With kind regards,

additional_info.body:
Dear Monica
Thank you for your reply.
However, I would like to stress once again that our main concern is the lack of direct and proactive communication regarding the intervention. We discussed this also in the meeting we had a few weeks ago.
We were not informed at all that someone had been on-site, nor that the situation had worsened. We only discovered this ourselves by checking the SCB platform. This is
not acceptable
given the operational impact.
We expect to be
personally informed immediately
when:
An intervention is planned, ongoing or there is an extra intervention needed
The station status changes (especially when it goes offline)
There are any relevant updates or outcomes from the site visit
We appreciate that the technician is present again today, and we await the service report. But going forward, we ask that you ensure transparent and timely communication — addressed directly to us — whenever such interventions take place.
Thank you for your understanding.
Met vriendelijke groeten | Cordialement | With kind regards,

“
Regional team (Planner) will inform Sparki on progress and provide a service report
